    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Notification" sourceRef="Start_Audit" targetRef="Task_SendNotification"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Provide_Review" sourceRef="Task_ProvideClarifications" targetRef="Task_ReviewSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDiscrepancies" sourceRef="Gateway_Discrepancies" targetRef="Gateway_RiskSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplit_Financial" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplit_Operational" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskSplit_Compliance" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskSplit" targetRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Financial_RiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateFinancialRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Operational_RiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateOperationalRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compliance_RiskJoin" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateComplianceRisks" targetRef="Gateway_RiskJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RiskJoin_HighRisk" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskJoin" targetRef="Gateway_HighRisk"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Launch_Analyze" sourceRef="Task_LaunchInvestigation" targetRef="Task_AnalyzeData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_Interviews" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzeData" targetRef="Task_ConductInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interviews_SiteVisit" sourceRef="Task_ConductInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SiteVisit_Conduct" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit" targetRef="Task_ConductSiteVisits">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${siteVisitsRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSiteVisit" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisit" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConductSiteVisit_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ConductSiteVisits" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitMerge"/>

rules.instruction: When the description presents activities or events in a chronological sequence, including how the process begins: Connect the corresponding BPMN elements with sequence flows in the stated order, including a flow from the start event to the first activity and flows between successive activities.
rules.situation: the description presents activities in a particular order, including activities following decision outcomes, a revision loop, or final process closure

rules.instruction: When the description names a specific activity and distinguishes it from a related preceding or subsequent activity: Label the BPMN activity with the action stated in the description; do not substitute a related action that the description treats as separate or does not state.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes an activity from a related action in another step

rules.instruction: When the description says an authorized person may approve an item, and later work proceeds only if it is approved: Model the approval as a distinct activity on the approved path, separate from the gateway that represents the approval decision, and connect it to the subsequent work.
rules.situation: the description says an authorized person may approve an item, and later work proceeds only if it is approved

rules.instruction: When the description states a meaningful object, recipient, or responsible role for an activity: Use a concise BPMN label that preserves the described action and those details when they distinguish or clarify the activity.
rules.situation: the description states a meaningful object, recipient, or responsible role for an activity

rules.instruction: When the description names an overall activity and separately describes constituent work or a conditional path within that activity: Model the named overall activity as a task in addition to representing the constituent work or conditional path when these are also described; do not let the latter replace the named activity.
rules.situation: the description names an overall activity and separately describes constituent work or a conditional path within that activity
